help.title: Help & FAQ
help.description: Common questions about campus parking and this system.

availability.question: How do I check parking availability?
availability.answer: The home page shows how many two-wheeler and four-wheeler spaces are free right now. Use Refresh to update the counts.

locations.question: Where are the parking areas?
locations.answer: The Parking locations section lists each parking block. When map coordinates have been configured, you can open the block's location in Google Maps.

fees.question: How much does parking cost?
fees.answer: The Parking fees section shows the official rules for staff, students and visitors, for two-wheelers and four-wheelers.

vehicle.question: Can I look up a parked vehicle here?
vehicle.answer: No. To protect privacy, vehicle numbers and parking records are not public. Please contact campus security staff for help.

login.question: Who can sign in?
login.answer: Administrators and security staff sign in at the staff sign-in page. Students and campus staff create an account and sign in with their e-mail address. Visitors need no account.

language.question: How do I change the language?
language.answer: Use the language menu at the top of the page to switch between English, Kannada, Hindi and Marathi.

register.question: How do I register as a student or staff member?
register.answer: Choose Create account, enter your details and your college or employee ID, then upload a photo or scan of your ID card. The document is seen only by administrators.

verification.question: Why is my account pending?
verification.answer: An administrator checks every ID once. Until it is approved you can sign in and see the status, but parking features and student or staff rates are not active. If it is rejected, you will see the reason and can submit a new document.

visitor.question: I am a visitor. How do I see my parking?
visitor.answer: Open Visitor parking and enter the vehicle number and session number printed on your slip. You can see only your own parking, your fee so far and your receipt after you leave.

findVehicle.question: How do I find my parked vehicle?
findVehicle.answer: Sign in and choose Locate my vehicle. Google Maps shows the parking block, and the CPVTS layout highlights your exact slot such as T-04. There is no turn-by-turn navigation.
